quests.title: Peseng's Zaytun Peaches

dialogue.t: Hmm... Which shop sells Zaytun Peaches? I can't remember...
Yes! My wife needs Zaytun Peaches for cooking meals. Ten peaches will do for a couple of days.
Do you have ten Zaytun Peaches?

dialogue.sit: Here are the Zaytun Peaches you wanted.

dialogue.t: These will do. I hope she'll feel better after seeing these, at least for the rest of the day.

quests.description: Peseng from Port Ormos needs ten Zaytun Peaches.
